description: Oracle improvement experiments, October 7, 2026. All accuracy_pct and gain/delta_pp values use percentage units. Main report uses family11 for scope/confirmation/pool, family8 for target/layer policies, and family3 for the old-protocol step bridge.

openbookqa_old_protocol.scope: Exploratory historical protocol bridge declared after primary OpenBookQA test; not part of the eight primary comparisons

arc_format_sensitivity.scope: Post-hoc alternative format metric, not a new primary test or selection. Preserve primary scores. Parser never consults gold when extracting; require unique standalone labeled option or explicit answer statement. Existing recognized/boxed answers take precedence.

primary_winner.scope: Exclude passages occurring in warmup/update/dev; descriptive subset, no selection or primary significance claim

primary_reference.scope: Exclude passages occurring in warmup/update/dev; descriptive subset, no selection or primary significance claim

fresh_warmup.scope: Exclude passages occurring in warmup/update/dev; descriptive subset, no selection or primary significance claim

scope_search.selection: Highest full-development accuracy; ties fewer parameters, fewer steps, lower LR, lexical arm; stop at Warmup unless strict improvement. Select overall winner and layer8 reference before final test.

target_layer.selection: Each arm selects full-development accuracy with seed101; ties fewer steps then lower LR; primary policy stops at Warmup unless strict improvement. Fixed-LR/step contrasts use the single-answer development recipe.
target_layer.teacher_filter: Same teacher-answer-verified training questions across all four arms; explanations not exhaustively verified; no student-success filter.

protocol.boolq_pool_bridge: Fixed historical Warmup, layer8 o_proj, LR3e-4, 256 steps; 1024 vs 4096 examples; five paired seeds. Recipe selected on expanded pool.
protocol.openbookqa_step_bridge: Original prompt, unfiltered 1024-example update pool, fixed historical Warmup, layer8 o_proj, LR1e-4; three paired seeds at32/128.
